pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Modern, 9.f4 Bd7 10.Qe1
pages.notes: The overview called the 10.Qe1 Classical Scheveningen the Keres Attack; plan 4 had a ...Nb8-d7-e5 route with the knight on c6; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 and 4 (...Nxd4 and ...Bc6 against e4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Classical, 7.O-O Be7
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Bg2 with the bishop on e2; plan 1 called f4 and g4 the Keres Attack; plan 2 called ...b5-b4 a minority attack. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Classical, 7.O-O Be7 8.f4 Qc7 9.Kh1
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Bg3 with no bishop able to reach g3 and Qf3 through the e2-bishop; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Scheveningen Variation, Classical Variation, Paulsen Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Qg3 with no route for the queen; plan 3 called ...b5-b4 a minority attack. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin-Najdorf
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Qe1-g3 route through the f2-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Sozin Attack, Flank Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had knight routes f3-e2-g3 and c2-e3 for a knight on d4. Rewrote plan 3 around Qf3 and e5 opening the diagonal to a8.

pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin-Najdorf, 7.Bb3 b5 8.O-O Be7 9.Qf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and claimed a queenside majority Black does not have (reviewer). Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin, 7.Be3 a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had the queen go to g4 or h5 and long castling without Qe2; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both around the Velimirovic Qe2 and O-O-O.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Najdorf Variation, English Attack, Anti-English
pages.notes: The overview called the e3-bishop light-squared; plan 2 said the g-file opens after an exchange on e3 (it is the f-file); plan 3 had an f3-g4 route. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 and 3 around 7.Bg5 h6 8.Bh4 g5 9.Bg3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Najdorf Variation, Freak Attack
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Ng5 with no knight able to reach it; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both.
